comment: The office's recorded ledger for the Accounting screen (/staff/accounting).
WHY THIS SHAPE EXISTS: the platform's accounting service exists and its posting-rule
contract is frozen, but NO staff-facing ledger API has frozen — so the screen reads
this APP-AUTHORED example ledger with provenance (the lot-lifecycle / guarantee-
instruments pattern). lib/api-client/accounting.ts is the only reader; live mode is
unimplemented and says so. Posting stays with the accounting service — this app only
WHAT IS REAL AND WHAT IS EXAMPLE:
· The chart of accounts and the amounts are EXAMPLE bookkeeping data. They are not
the client's books and no client document is transcribed here.
· Entries that name an order (ORD-2026-…) carry that order's own total from
commerce/orders.json, and entries that name a case use a real case number from
references so the ledger cannot point at a document that does not exist.
· Every entry's debit side equals its credit side; the trial balance is DERIVED from
these lines by lib/accounting.ts, never stored here.
READ-ONLY: no posting, reversal, closing or write path exists on the screen.
CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the recorded demo records are REMOVED. The office's reference data is kept; a record is written only when the office actually records one.
